title: OpenAI says heavy ChatGPT users may hit limits sooner as it merges Chat and Work
lede: OpenAI has begun merging ChatGPT's Chat and Work experiences under one shared usage meter, and says a small share of its heaviest users may reach their limits sooner.

points: The unified experience is reaching a small group of Pro subscribers first, product lead Thibault Sottiaux said on X.
Chat and Work will draw from a single allowance across ChatGPT.
Conversations on the Instant model stay unlimited, do not count against the meter, and keep working after limits run out.
OpenAI's support page says shared limits roll out more broadly in December.
Anthropic made a similar move in September, putting Claude chat and Cowork in one interface.

sections.text: Anyone who leans on ChatGPT's reasoning models for agentic Work tasks now spends the same budget as their chats, so heavy use of one eats into the other.
